Integrate Codeoff with shared notifications (#156)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-30
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    
    - add strict shared Webhook destination and delivery policy configuration for Codeoff
    - add a dedicated SQLite notification outbox and shared delivery worker with durable retry, fencing, ambiguity, restart, and retention behavior
    - emit five typed terminal scheduler events without changing existing Slack or scheduler ownership
    - cover future Slack rendering compatibility and Markdown/plaintext Webhook delivery
    
    ## Verification
    
    - `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
    - `cargo clippy --all-features -p codeoo-notification -p codeoo-notification-core -p codeoo-notification-webhook -p codeoff-config -p codeoff-state -p codeoff-runtime -p codeoff-mcp -p codeoff-channel-slack -p codeoff-cli -- -D warnings`
    - `cargo test --all-features -p codeoo-notification -p codeoo-notification-core -p codeoo-notification-webhook -p codeoff-config -p codeoff-state -p codeoff-runtime -p codeoff-mcp -p codeoff-channel-slack -p codeoff-cli`
